title: Microsoft 365 Apps Install Failed
description: Detects when the Microsoft 365 Apps (Office Click-to-Run) install failed. The V2 OfficeInstallDetector watches the C2R client directly (registry, Delivery Optimization, process) and emits office_install_failed when the C2R INSTALL scenario records an error code. Completion is proven by the core Office binaries on disk; an install window that closes without that proof ends silently, never as a failure. This catches Office failures the deployment status hides: the Intune built-in app type is marked done once the configuration is delivered, and a Win32 or RealmJoin package once its installer exits, while C2R keeps installing in the background.
explanation:
The Microsoft 365 Apps (Office Click-to-Run) install failed.

The OfficeInstallDetector watches the C2R client directly and reports the real install lifecycle, however it was started. The Intune built-in Microsoft 365 Apps app type delivers the configuration through the Office CSP and lets the device start C2R; a Win32 or RealmJoin package runs the Office Deployment Tool. Either way the deployment is marked done before C2R has finished laying down the product. This event means C2R recorded an error code in its INSTALL scenario before the core Office apps were on disk.

Review the office_install_failed event payload: `products`, `channel`, `errorCode`, `errorSource` (the C2R registry value that carried the code) and `durationSeconds`.

remediation.title: Investigate the Office C2R install failure
steps: Open the office_install_failed event and review products, channel, errorCode and errorSource
Check the Click-to-Run logs on the device (%windir%\Temp and %temp%, files named <MachineName>-yyyymmdd-nnnn.log) for the failing operation
Verify the device had network reachability to the Office CDN / Microsoft Connected Cache during the enrollment window
Confirm the Intune Microsoft 365 Apps app configuration (products, channel, architecture) matches what the device can install
Re-check the session timeline for a reboot or agent shutdown that may have interrupted the background C2R install
